avis.texte: I am a skincare lover who has tried everything under the sun from high end products to dollar store products and everything in between! I was pleasantly surprised by this toner and have added it into my regular skincare routine. I like to use this with a cotton pad in the evenings before my other products go on. I find that the level of chemical exfoliation is just right and I haven't had any issues with irritation. I think for the price, this is a phenomenal option for a gentle exfoliating toner! Thank you to BzzAgent for gifting this to me!
I really like the toner I think my skin it's just too dry but over all it was a good Experience I think it's very good

this had PHA for exfoliating and the centella is so soothing. this plus the cosrx snail mucin is perfect for irritated skin (dry cold weather for example) and watery so spreads easily. would recommend for all skin types including oily.

I have dry skin, I'm not acne-prone, and this toner has become a reliable step in my extensive Korean skincare routine. The texture is lightweight and watery, but it's surprisingly comforting — it sinks in quickly without leaving any tightness or residue. My skin immediately feels calmed, refreshed, and balanced, which makes it a perfect prep step before essences and serums. The Centella really shines here: it reduces redness and sensitivity without feeling like a "treatment" product. Despite being a toning toner, it's not stripping at all. My skin stays soft and receptive rather than dry or squeaky. I often apply it in 2–3 layers using the patting method, and it layers beautifully without pilling. This is not a flashy, instant-glow product — it's a quiet, skin-health staple. If you have dry, sensitive, or dehydrated skin and want something that supports your routine rather than competing with it, this is an excellent choice. Best for: dry, sensitive, or barrier-focused routines Not ideal if: you're looking for exfoliation or actives

received this free in exchange for my honest review. This product is pretty nice. It has a brightening effect and feels nice on my skin. I've been using it on and off for about 2 months now but have not really noticed a huge change in my skin. My skin felt good when I used it also and didn't feel any more dry than usual so it's nice that it was exfoliating without it drying. Overall I liked it and will continue to use it.

The Madagascar Centella Toning Toner is lightweight, calming, and great for reducing redness. It absorbs quickly and feels soothing on sensitive skin. It's not a dramatic, results‑driven toner, but it's a reliable, gentle option if you want hydration and balance without irritation.

This is my go to when my skin needs extra tlc in the winter months. It is incredibly hydrating while keeping oil at bay. It absorbs beautifully without leaving a tacky feeling on the skin. I haven't had any issues while using and will definitely be repurchasing when this bottle is done. I received this sample from bzzagent in exchange for my honest review

*Skin1004 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program* I have pretty sensitive skin. I've been trying new products and this one has been gentle enough to make my skin supple. Most problematic concern I am having right now is textured skin. It works pretty well, but, I will say, this serves a different purpose. I wouldn't necessarily compare it to my other products as it has a different exfoliating purpose. I usually love milky toners, but this is nice as the toner after my soothing toner since it's exfoliating. Then, I can layer with my milky toners for more hydration. I think after some more time I would buy it. I actually use the ampoule from this line already so I like that the exfoliating toner makes it a full circle! So far my skin has been super supple and smooth and having less breakouts. I would definitely recommend it to my friends and family. I've actually been using it on my Auntie as well. She is 88 years old and it's been working for her and doesn't make her read. Looking forward to using this more often for more results!

This toner feels so refreshing after I clean my face. It absorbs quickly into the skin and feels light weight and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. It provides a mild exfoliation without irritating the skin. My skin feels more hydrated and calm. I can't wait to keep using it and hopefully see my skin improving.

avis.titre: Light, watery, and chef's kiss calming.
avis.texte: This toner absorbs in seconds, chills out redness, and leaves skin feeling clean, balanced, and bouncy—zero stickiness, zero drama. It's my go-to when my skin is acting up or post-breakout and just needs peace, not a lecture. Layers beautifully under everything, but this isn't a "burn your face off" exfoliant or a heavy hydrator. It's that low-key, dependable product that quietly makes your skin better—and suddenly you're mad you didn't try it sooner.

This Toner is great for my skin. Using a cotton pad, i dab it all over my face, neck, and chest. It is a great first step in prepping my skin. It says its meant for exfoliating but I dont get any qualities that feel like its exfoliating my skin. It does refresh my skin with a boost of hydration. My skin has felt more smooth after using this because it absorbs really quickly. The applicating part is a small hole in which you drip product out of which prevents a nig spill where all the product pours out because the hole is too big. I get to use just the right amount for my body. Thanks Skin1004 for the free product.

I received this product from Skin1004 in exchange for my honest opinion and it does what it says it does! Provides mild exfoliation without stripping skin of its natural oils and tones skin very well. I have slightly textured skin and this toner noticeably smooths out texture leaving my skin feeling extra soft. It doesn't dry out my skin and doesn't leave a sticky residue. There's a lot of toners that don't absorb into my skin like this one does. Note that I have combination skin and after using this toner, my face feels clean and nourished reducing shine from having oily skin. It hasn't made me breakout at all and provides instant hydration. I love that this toner has Centella Asiatica extract from Madagascar as a main ingredient.

I really liked this toner. It was very gentle for my sensitive and dry skin. It absorbs quickly and I use it after cleansing. No irritation experienced. After two weeks use, I notice my skin was clearer and even tone. You can use it with a cotton pad or pat by hand. Skin1004 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program.

This toner is great for my skin. I've noticed a glow after 3 uses. My skin feels fresh and soft. This is easy to use and my skin absorbes it very well. I received this for free in exchange for an honest review.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again for sure

Thank you for sending me this product in exchange for my honest review . I saw an improvement on my skin . It leaves my face feeling soft and my skin texture has improved since using this product .

Overall, it's a really nice formula that I will continue to use.

avis.titre: Fits easily into any skincare routine
avis.texte: The Madagascar Centella Toning Toner is lightweight, soothing, and perfect for sensitive skin. It absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin hydrated. This toner fits easily into any skincare routine.

avis.titre: This line has transformed my skin
avis.texte: I love this line so much! It's taken my skin from dry and dull to supple and soft. I've never used anything from the centella line that I didn't like. My favorite way to use the toner is "flooding". After cleansing I will apply about 5-7 thin layers, allowing it to dry in between and then finishing off with the moisturizer. I wake up GLOWING! Highly recommend!
This toner really hydrates my skin. It prepares the skin after cleansing it for rest of the skincare products. Very soothing and refreshing. It absorbs quickly. Minimizes pore and texture from skin.

avis.titre: Gentle and Refreshing: Centella Toner Review
avis.texte: Thanks to SKIN1004 and BzzAgent for the free sample! I received this toner for free through BzzAgent, and I'm sharing my honest opinion based on my personal experience. I like how this toner feels on the skin: it's lightweight, absorbs quickly, doesn't leave any stickiness, and doesn't irritate my skin. I noticed that my skin started to look calmer and more even — especially after using it regularly in the morning and evening. The Centella toner gives a nice refreshing effect, and the feeling of "clean, balanced skin" lasts for a long time. The results aren't instant — you really start to see changes after 1–2 weeks of consistent use. If there's anything I would improve, it would be adding instructions in multiple languages, depending on the market. Overall, I'm happy with this toner: it hydrates well and provides gentle care. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a light, plant-based toner that works well for sensitive or normal skin.

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Toning Toner and it is such a calming, skin soothing staple. The texture is lightweight and watery, so it absorbs instantly without leaving any film which is perfect if you're using active ingredients like Clindamycin or Tretinoin (it doesn't irritate at all, and I use both plus have sensitive skin).What I love most is how gentle it is. The Centella extract really helps calm redness, balance my skin, and keep it hydrated without clogging pores. It gives that fresh, healthy glow without being heavy or sticky. My skin looks smoother, feels softer, and stays way less irritated on the days I'm using stronger treatments.If you need a toner that's calming, hydrating, and sensitive-skin friendly, this one is such a good pick. Definitely staying in my routine.

thank you skin 1004 for gifting me this toner! first things first i was very excited to try this toner bc i had never heard of centella or pha acids before. the toner itself was gentle enough for everyday and didn't irritate my hand eczema which is a plus with me using any exfoliating toner. i used it twice a day for a week and did notice the dead skin off my face but without having my face feel dry like it would with a retinol product. my skin also looked noticeably brighter which was another huge plus. i would compare this product to a glycolic toner but without leaving the skin dry and leaving you with brighter skin. my only downfall was that i noticeed my undereye skin was a bit more dry :( i do happen to have dry undereyes since i am in my 30s but if i was still in my 20s this product would indeed be a staple in my routine. all in all if you dont have dry undereyes i would highly recommend this toner!
This is a decent to er that doesn't dry out my dry skin during the winter time. I'm not a huge toner fan but do not mind using this and helps to balance the skin.

This toner has a watery consistency and is very lightweight. I use a cotton ball to apply it and it absorbs quickly. I have oily skin but my cheeks get dry during the cooler months. So far my skin has been responding well to this toner and I'll definitely be finishing the bottle!

It dries easily and so far ive seen a very small improvement in my overall skin and how my face looks, There is more of a balance and less pigmentation. I did receive a sample for free.

I received this toner as a gift in exchange for my honest review. I have used the Toner for a little over a week daily and although I have not noticed a HUGE difference in my skin I have enjoyed it. I have applied the Toner with a cotton pad as instructions mentioned you could. I will say my skin has felt slightly softer. I wish it had some sort of scent but understand this would be perfect for someone who does not want any scents or fragrances in their skin products. Overall I would currently recommend the product and look forward to seeing if there are any majorly noticeable improvements with longer continued use.

Love this product, a great addition to my routine. It makes my skin feel so soft and clean. I feel like my skin has a glow! There is no smell to this product which I appreciate.

It absorbs right away, doesn't feel sticky, and gives that fresh, hydrated glow. If your skin is sensitive or gets easily irritated, this toner is definitely worth trying!

It contains PHA for a very gentle daily exfoliation, improving texture without drying out the skin. Ideal for soothing, balancing, and lightly hydrating the skin without a sticky feeling.
